name: fe-fe5-inspector-local-transform
title: Electron UI FE5: inspector transform row switches to the local transform (GetEntity + SetLocalTransform) so it matches the gizmo, with Euler display and multi-object editing of shared fields
issue: Roadmap C:/Method Notes Obsidian/orchestrator/proposals/electron-ui-roadmap.md (section 4 for the inspector transform part: FE5; and the multi-edit part of section 11 'multi-select (what remains)' for multi-edit in the inspector), decision U5 (switch the inspector's transform row to the LOCAL transform: GetEntity + SetLocalTransform, Euler shown, quaternion sent, so it matches the gizmo; today the row uses the legacy world Euler commands). Read src/renderer/inspector-panel.tsx, inspector-editors.tsx, inspector-fields.ts, inspector-state.ts, the transform editor, how the gizmo writes the local transform (viewport-controller.ts) and the engine docs for GetEntity/SetLocalTransform (engine repo docs/editor.html READ-ONLY) FIRST. SCOPE: (1) the transform row shows and edits LOCAL position/rotation/scale: rotation displayed as Euler degrees (decide the order/convention from the engine docs and the gizmo's maths, and document it), edits converted to a quaternion and sent with SetLocalTransform in one edit step per commit (typing then Enter/blur), undo works, values stay stable on round trips (no drift from Euler<->quaternion conversions: preserve the last edited Euler triple while editing, gimbal cases tested), live refresh when the gizmo or another client changes the object, world values may be shown read-only as a tooltip/secondary row only if cheap; (2) MULTI-EDIT: when several objects are selected the inspector shows shared components' fields with mixed-value indicators; editing a field applies to ALL selected objects as ONE edit group (one undo step), only for field types the roadmap lists, with a clear 'N objects' header, read-only/viewer respected, partial failure handling (a failed object rolls the group back or reports, per the roadmap's decision: follow it), (3) tests: pure Euler/quaternion helpers (round trips, gimbal, negative zero, large angles, wrap), inspector state for mixed values, DOM tests for transform edit/undo, multi-edit group count with a fake backend, read-only; README updated. Frontend rules: requiresDocs false (README only); run npm run typecheck and npm test locally before every push; no token in logs/storage; keep changes inside the files your lane owns (other frontend lanes are in flight at the same time: keymap action registrations and README additions will conflict mechanically, keep them as small separate hunks); no engine/protocol change unless this item says so. Read the roadmap section named in this item, decisions U1-U21 (all ACCEPTED by the user on 2026-10-20), the frontend README and the code you touch FIRST; F1 (panel registry/layout) and F2 (prefs store and keymap) are merged: use them (register panels through the registry, shortcuts through the keymap, preferences through the prefs store).
acceptance: Inspector transform row edits the local transform consistently with the gizmo, stable Euler display, one edit step per commit
Multi-object editing of shared fields with mixed-value indicators as one edit group; read-only respected
Unit and DOM tests; frontend CI green; README updated
notes: Reviewer: Euler/quaternion conversion correctness and stability (no drift while editing), local vs world semantics identical to the gizmo, one edit group per commit/multi-edit, mixed-value handling, partial-failure behaviour, read-only, tests meaningful, mediums count.
